title: Overlay
description: A single timed on-screen overlay rendered by the broadcast UI.

start_ms.title: Start Ms
start_ms.description: Overlay appears at this match clock.

end_ms.title: End Ms
end_ms.description: Overlay disappears at this match clock.

match_clock_ms.title: Match Clock Ms
match_clock_ms.description: Clock the overlay is anchored to.

title.title: Title
title.description: Short headline shown above the body.

body.title: Body
body.description: The narrative text of the overlay.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: The numbers the narrative rests on.

cited_event_ids.title: Cited Event Ids
cited_event_ids.description: Event ids the narrative rests on.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Confidence in the narrative, between 0 and 1.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Which version of this overlay this is. An overlay keeps its id when the audience changes, so the studio needs a number to tell the new card from the old one.

provenance_provider.title: Provenance Provider
provenance_provider.description: Which provider served the call that wrote this card's prose, if a model was asked. None when the card is fully deterministic. This is provenance, not a claim: the badge still shows the provider of the last call overall.

prose_substituted.title: Prose Substituted
prose_substituted.description: Whether the model's prose was rejected by the figure check and replaced with deterministic copy in the requested audience and language. The studio labels such a card, because its words are not the model's.

deterministic_prose.title: Deterministic Prose
deterministic_prose.description: Whether the card's prose is fully deterministic -- no model call behind it. The full-time recap is deterministic, and the studio labels it as such.

OverlayType.title: OverlayType
OverlayType.description: What kind of overlay this is, which decides how the UI renders it.

MetricValue.title: MetricValue
MetricValue.description: A single number shown next to an insight, with its unit and a label.

name.title: Name
name.description: Machine name of the metric, e.g. 'pass_accuracy'.

side.title: Side
side.description: Which side the number describes, when the insight is about one side. The grounding step recomputes the metric over the cited events for this side.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The person the number is about, when it is about a player rather than a side.
